decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop uses existing sheltered-workshop know-how and infrastructure, so the option costs little to hold while custom-furniture demand is still being revealed.

The retail shop still has only a low profile on the website and carries fixed costs, but it supports workshop sales and gives an outlet for products like the new carpentry line, so its value is not yet resolved and the option stays open.

Meal delivery for seniors launched only in 2024, sits close to the established eldercare offer and can use existing kitchens and logistics, so it is too early to judge its value and keeping it is cheap.
